items.text: I signed on to @RepGarbarino H.R. 549, the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act, because I believe that patients suffering from breast cancer should not have to wait to receive care. https://t.co/jEToYcvlH3

My bill that works to improve treatment and services for children, adolescents, and families who have experienced traumatic events just passed on the House floor.

I am grateful to the bipartisan leadership that made this possible. We must work to reauthorize and provide resources to improve the National Child Traumatic Stress Initiative.

This week, my staff met with @FeedingTexas to discuss several nutrition issues. 

I was proud to recently introduce the Healthy Babies Act. This bill would expand which healthy baby food options are available under WIC. It’s critical that our children have access to nutritious foods.

I recently met with Mario Obledo of the @safoodbank. We discussed the importance of nutrition programs and food banks in TX-15 and the state of Texas. Mario, thanks for an informative discussion. https://t.co/9p8a6Lkm7I

Breast Cancer Awareness Month aims to educate and express the importance of early detection while celebrating advancements in treatment. 1 in 8 women will be diagnosed with breast cancer in her lifetime. As the Bipartisan Women's Caucus Vice Chair, I am determined to improve access to early detection screenings.

I am a proud Co-Sponsor of the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare MCED Screening Coverage Act. This bill allows for Medicare coverage and payment of multi-cancer early detection screening tests. Early detection saves lives, and I am determined to increase access to healthcare in the RGV.

My legislative director recently met with Omar Rodriguez, the director of grants and government relations at the Food Bank of the Rio Grande Valley. It was an insightful meeting, and the importance of the Farm Bill and its role in supporting nutrition programs was a main topic of discussion. Thank you, Omar, and the Food Bank of the RGV for serving our community.
My legislative director recently met with Mario Obledo from the @safoodbank to discuss the Farm Bill and the importance of nutrition programs throughout Texas. https://t.co/yNl88M2mmL

During National Salute to Veteran Patients Week, we take a moment to honor and recognize the strength and courage of all veterans in protecting our freedom. I will always advocate for honoring those who have made the ultimate sacrifice. We thank you. https://t.co/m5fNgy3YKh

My legislative team met with Jesus Avendano, a governing board member of the @texasaeyc. We discussed nutrition programs, childcare services, and potential legislative solutions. I will continue to fight to increase access to quality early education. https://t.co/VjfG00BAzl

Today’s CR funds the government through the end of FY25 and delivers on Americans’ key priorities: 

✅ Extends the National Flood Insurance Program to ensure affordable insurance for homeowners across South Texas
✅ Supports nutrition assistance for Texas families
✅ Fully funds health care and benefits for Veterans

My bipartisan SPEAK Act ensures all patients have access to health information, empowers informed decisions, and promotes better communication with healthcare providers to address the barriers of those with limited English proficiency. I will always fight to make healthcare more accessible!

Read more here: https://t.co/oDVdSa0RsP
Thank you to the @foodbankrgv and the @safoodbank  for visiting the office and discussing the importance of food nutrition assistance programs. https://t.co/fdphq7oTKq

My district team joined the 10th anniversary celebration of @stxhealthsystem ER in the @CityOfMissionTX. Since its opening, it’s served over 200,00 patients, including 76,000 children! STHC provides quality care and plays a vital role in supporting our Customs and Border Patrol Agents. Thank you, healthcare workers and RGV EMS!

Connally Medical Center held a ribbon cutting for its newest medical facility in @floresvilletx last week. Congrats on this new facility and making healthcare more accessible in Wilson County. https://t.co/rSmq0DegKb

All Americans – regardless of native language – should be able to access the quality health care they need. My bipartisan SPEAK Act will establish best practices for patients and providers to communicate in multiple languages. I penned an op-ed alongside @LIBREinitiative's @danielggarza on this critical issue – read more here: https://t.co/Hvam0Q3j4L

My staff had a great meeting with Don McBeath from @torchnet. They discussed the importance of improving healthcare access in rural areas and walked through the SPEAK Act—legislation I recently introduced to ensure patients have a voice when it comes to their care. I’ll always stand up for rural communities and fight to expand access to quality healthcare across South Texas.

Great to tour the @foodbankrgv—the 7th largest food bank in Texas—and meet with their team to discuss their work to help South Texans through food assistance, nutrition education, and access to community services. https://t.co/uU0gBVUkWN
My staff had a productive meeting with @AmCollSurgeons to discuss ways we can improve health care policies and ensure better outcomes for patients and providers alike. https://t.co/Qu4uWh6BGO

Our staff had the pleasure of attending Direct Auto Insurance of Mission’s 22nd Anniversary Ribbon Cutting with the @missionchamber of Commerce. We were proud to celebrate this local small business and its incredible milestone alongside fellow community leaders. https://t.co/vDznCNAASv

At a recent ribbon cutting with Meadows Psychotherapy & Assessment and the @EdinburgChamber of Commerce, our team was proud to celebrate the arrival of this new mental wellness provider serving our region. https://t.co/7AmwJ0cTzM
It was great to meet with @bread4theworld and Sister Norma to discuss hunger, nutrition, and ways we can support families facing food insecurity in South Texas. https://t.co/RIRgTZ3sJj

I enjoyed my time with Rio Grande Valley Builders Association discussing housing priorities for the Valley and my work to find affordable housing solutions as Vice Chair of the Housing and Insurance Subcommittee in Congress. https://t.co/urVOweYTqG

Passed: MilCon-VA Appropriations Bill 🇺🇸✅

Proud to support government funding legislation to:
- Expand housing access for our servicemembers, Veterans, and military families
- Allocate over $400 billion for Veteran healthcare, benefits, and critical VA programs
- Honor our heroes by preserving military cemeteries and memorials across the nation

Great to join my co-chair, @RepEmiliaSykes, in sharing the BWC’s priorities with the supporters of the @WCPInst this week.

Together, we’re working to empower American women and families by:

- Promoting women-owned small businesses
- Expanding access to childcare and nutrition programs
- Improving care for the elderly and women Veterans
- Strengthening trauma and PTSD resources
- Advancing the Women’s History Museum on the National Mall
